description: Shape series: a 26 x 8 corridor. Length, with nowhere to circle.
notes: Four rooms, one roster. Every encounter below spawns exactly one guard and one duelist in a single wave with no time limit, so the only thing that varies between them is the floor they are fought on. Two enemy types is the corpus's "regular" palette — enough for a relationship between archetypes, few enough that the room stays the thing being read.
They are instruments, not rungs. Nothing here belongs on the route until one of them produces a reason to prefer its shape.
